items.title: Jimmy Owens — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Morty Bullman was a very fine trombonist who worked with the Arthur Godfrey Show... He was Carmine Caruso’s first brass student

ctx.x: … Jimmy Owens, Dick Hurwitz on trumpet, and Morty Bullman on trombone.
Morty Bullman was a very fine trombonist who worked with the Arthur Godfrey Show, had done all these things. He was Carmine Caruso’s first brass student, okay? This was in the early 50’s.
